Job Summary:
Aptive seeks a Senior Interoperability Architect to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Office of Clinical Informatics (OCI) on the Operational Informatics Pipeline (OIP) contract. You will develop, refine, and maintain the interoperability specifications, including standards, data models, and profiles, that define how Veteran health information moves between VistA/CPRS, the Federal Electronic Health Record (EHR), the Department of Defense, and community providers. The role supports the Interoperability specialty area, including the Veterans Health Information Exchange (VHIE), FHIR standards innovation, standards-based interfaces, and national exchange frameworks. You will work within Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) Agile Release Trains alongside interoperability specialists, terminologists, and VA Business Owners.
Primary Responsibilities

•
Interoperability Specifications. Develop, refine, and maintain interoperability specifications, including standards, data models, profiles, and implementation guides, for VA exchange use cases.

•
Standards Analysis. Analyze industry standards, VHA business requirements, and relevant technological innovation to recommend specification approaches.

•
HL7 and FHIR Design. Design solutions using HL7 V2, C-CDA, and FHIR, including FHIR profiles and API specifications that extend VA’s use of standards-based APIs.

•
Community Care and Partner Exchange. Define specifications that support exchange with community care providers, the Department of Defense, and other partners, aligned to national exchange frameworks.

•
Device and System Interfaces. Develop standards-based specifications for device and system interfaces that support the Federal EHR.

•
Discovery Projects. Lead discovery and prototyping for new standards needs, such as consent management and time zone interoperability.

•
Conformance and Adoption. Define conformance criteria and testing approaches, and track adoption of standards across VA systems and exchange partners.

•
Federal Policy Alignment. Align specifications with the ONC Standards & Interoperability (S&I) Framework, USCDI, and applicable federal interoperability policy.

•

Why you should join us
Jerry .ai is a profitable, Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. We’re building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with the car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat) and accelerating our growth.
About this role
We’re at an inflection point in our journey. After 2 years of profitable growth with a stable core business (car insurance marketplace), we’re ready to expand our product offerings and accelerate customer growth.
We’re looking for 2-3 Product Managers to drive progress across one of our key new product bets, including motorcycle insurance (just launched), home insurance (also just launched), new insurance products for other assets like boat and RV (concept phase), as well as non-insurance products to make car and home ownership easier such as helping customers save money on their property taxes (about to launch).
Each of these new product areas comes with its own operational complexity, its own customer personas and painpoints, and its own path to scale. And we’re looking for builders who are excited to take ownership of one of these new bets.
Why you will (or won't) like working here

• 0-to-1 scope: The products you will work on are new territory for us. There are no established frameworks, no prior PM who has figured it out.

• Product complexity: Property tax rules vary county by county. Specialty vehicle insurance involves regulatory and product complexity that doesn't exist in standard auto. These are not clean, well-scoped problems to solve.

• Real impact: You will have meaningful ownership. And what you do will likely materially impact the trajectory of our business over the next few years.

What you'll own
There are several new product bets in the motion. The specific product you will work on will largely depend on your prior experience, interests/preferences, and our business priorities when you join the team.
The goal in every case remains the same: ramp quickly on a new domain, distill data and insights to identify the highest leverage areas to prioritize (including quantitative data from our Data Science team and qualitative data from our Customer Insights & Research team), build and ship new products, get customer feedback quickly, apply learnings and iterate, and compound on what works.
Whether it’s home, motorcycle, boat or RV products, you will be a key contributor to our product roadmap and own execution from early concept or early launch to finding product-market fit, and scaling.

• An owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.

• Empathetic & Curious: You care deeply about understanding what drives how they think, feel and behave.

• Diligent: Your follow through is impeccable. When you own something, nothing falls through the cracks.

What you bring

• 5+ years in management consulting (MBB or equivalent), consumer-facing product management, or equivalent role at a high-growth startup

• Consumer product instincts, either from direct product building experience or from close work alongside consumer product teams

• Comfort with data: able to run your own analysis and build conviction from messy signals
